title: 2 Hour Dolphin Watching Adventure in Calabash
includes: We kindly ask guests to consider a customary gratuity for our crew, typically between 15% and 20% (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Essentials: Layered, comfy clothing, non-slip shoes, sun protection (hat, SPF, sunglasses), and a camera or smartphone.
Optional: Light snacks and water (or purchase onboard), a small cooler, and seasickness meds if needed.
Leave Behind: Glass containers and large bags—space is limited!
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Set sail on a Dolphin & Wildlife Adventure Cruise, one of the top must‑do experiences near Myrtle Beach! Departing from the charming Calabash Waterfront, this relaxing journey takes you through the vibrant coastal ecosystem of the Carolinas in search of fascinating marine life.

Perfect for families, couples, friends, and solo explorers, this cruise offers a close‑up look at nature at its finest—all from the comfort of a spacious, well‑equipped vessel.
